business_overview.one_sentence: The Group is principally engaged in OEM garment manufacturing and sales, specialising in sleepwear, loungewear, greige fabric and processing services.

segments.name: Single operating segment: manufacturing and sales of sleepwear products, loungewear products, greige fabric and processing services
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements, note 6

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly fixed-price product sales recognised when goods are shipped to the customer's location; normal credit period is 0 to 120 days.
business_notes: Production facilities are in Henan, PRC, Phnom Penh, Cambodia and Honduras; Vietnam production was subcontracted and a Vietnam facility was under construction in 2023.
Customer concentration is high: Customer A contributed HK$922.276 million and Customer B HK$150.066 million of 2023 revenue.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Includes foreign exchange loss, expected-credit-loss reversal and fair value losses on financial assets.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2023, Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss and note 8

non_recurring_items.item: Net realised and unrealised fair value loss on FVTPL bonds and funds
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Market value movement and realised gain/loss on non-operating financial assets.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash on hand and in bank; management discussion says 73.2% USD, 23.0% RMB, 0.9% HKD and 2.9% other currencies.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, Management Discussion and Analysis and note 22

funds_assets.business_substance: Listed bonds with fixed interest rates of 3.750% to 7.950% and maturities from 14 January 2024 to 17 August 2026.
USD-denominated bond funds operated by banks and investment management firms.
Investment funds operated by investment management firms.

operating_assets.business_substance: Garment manufacturing inventory and related production materials.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, Consolidated Statement of Financial Position

operating_assets.business_substance: Trade receivables, prepayments to import-export corporations, deposits, tax recoverable and other receivables.
Receivables arising from product sales, measured at FVTOCI; operating working-capital asset rather than detachable treasury cash.

operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2023, Consolidated Statement of Financial Position

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Operating leases for continuing business; considered in liquidity and profit quality rather than deducted as detachable-cash debt in the main owner-earnback calculation.

Annual Report 2023, Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year median operating cash flow exceeded median parent net profit, but 2021 absorbed material working capital and the business has customer concentration and expansion needs. Main calculation uses median parent net profit less median capex, then applies a 0.75 cash-profit haircut.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2023, Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss, p.47 / text lines 2270-2345
Annual Report 2023, Management Discussion and Analysis / text lines 291-296

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company versus each subsidiary for the whole cash balance.

The annual report discloses no restricted cash line, but pledged assets with net book value HK$121.5 million were provided for unutilised banking facilities; the pledged asset composition is not fully tied to cash.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed from growth capex; median purchase of property, plant and equipment is used as a conservative proxy.
